payload.blocks: The peer-link part of the gateway-cluster design (ds-64l3h22msc): how one gateway finds and reaches another. The doorbell message and the component split do not wait on it.
payload.headline: Gateway cluster: which network do your machines share, so gateways can reach each other directly?

parts.cause: The gateway binds 0.0.0.0:4170 (logs to 2026-10-25) and has an opt-in Cloudflare Access check (apps/fgos-gateway/src/cf_access.rs), so it was reachable from outside once. I cannot see from here whether fg-server, fg-server2 and design-lap share a LAN, a VPN such as Tailscale, or only the internet and the git remote.

scope.allows: Recording the network you name as the peer-link assumption of the design.
scope.forbids: Opening ports, installing a VPN or changing any machine.

parts.what: For gateways on different machines to join one cluster, each needs a network path to the others. Identity already has confirmed machine keys (fgos identity pins: ssh-ed25519 per machine), which can prove who a peer is whatever the path is.
